result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off. The full name is not visible, suggesting the text is being clipped without an ellipsis or proper wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Add text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width, or allow the card to be wide enough to display the full restaurant name. Alternatively, reduce font size or allow two-line truncation.

issues.description: The last category filter button (rightmost) in the horizontal scroll row is partially cut off, showing only a sliver of a pill/button element. While horizontal scrolling is likely intended, there is no visual affordance (e.g., fade/gradient) indicating more items exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient overlay to the category filter row to visually communicate that more items are available by scrolling horizontally.
